data.name: Cookie
data.headline: Falkirk's Trusted Plumber — Cookie's Got It Covered
data.aboutText: Cookie has been keeping Falkirk's homes and businesses running smoothly, one pipe at a time. Based right here in Randolph Crescent, we're your local first call for everything from a dripping tap to a full bathroom transformation. No call centres, no fuss — just honest, reliable plumbing from someone who knows the area.

services.name: Emergency Callouts
services.blurb: Burst pipe at midnight or a boiler that's packed in on a cold morning — Cookie gets to you fast when it matters most.

services.name: Boiler Repair & Installation
services.blurb: Whether your boiler needs a fix or it's time for a full replacement, Cookie handles it safely and efficiently to keep your home warm.

services.name: Bathroom Installation
services.blurb: From a fresh shower enclosure to a complete bathroom overhaul, Cookie takes the stress out of the job and leaves you with a finish you'll love.

services.name: Leak Detection
services.blurb: Hidden leaks can cause serious damage fast — Cookie tracks down the source quickly and sorts it before it becomes a bigger problem.
